identificationModule.briefTitle: Adebrelimab Combined With Fluzoparib in HRD-positive HR +/HER2- Advanced Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Single-arm Study of Adebrelimab Combined With Fluzoparib in HRD-positive HR +/HER2- Advanced Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label, single-arm, exploratory study planned to include 40 patients with HRD-positive HR +/HER2- advanced breast cancer treated with Adebrelimab in combination with fluzoparib. To observe and evaluate the efficacy and safety of Adebrelimab combined with fluzoparib in the treatment of HRD-positive HR +/HER2-advanced breast cancer

conditions: Histopathologically Confirmed Advanced HR +/HER2-invasive Breast Cancer
